title: Change mark rates across proposal lines
steps: Inspect the two free-text service lines, their buying costs, selling prices, and 20% mark rates.
Click the edit icon in the Mark rate column header and enter 25%.
Click Update and inspect the updated line prices and mark rates alongside the error message.

video_guide.summary: Compare the recalculated service prices with the error notification: the update succeeds, but the page reports missing parameters.

chapters.note: Two manually entered service lines start at 20% mark rate: selling prices EUR100 and EUR50, with costs EUR80 and EUR40.
The column-header mark-rate editor contains 25 beside Update.
Both rates now show 25% and the line totals are EUR106.67 and EUR53.33, but two Wrong or missing parameters messages appear at the top right.
The error remains visible alongside the updated amounts and EUR160 selling-price total.
